_doc: MCP servers HQ connects to at startup. See agent/src/hq_agent/mcp.py for the format. Secrets come from .env via ${VAR}. Restart the agent (make restart) after editing.

github._doc: GitHub's hosted MCP server. Skipped until GITHUB_MCP_TOKEN is set. Patterns match GitHub's tool names; anything not listed is never given to that agent.
